# Business Builder

> Websites, hosting, AI automation, and AI voice agents for small businesses. Based in Rutland, Massachusetts (Worcester County); serving Worcester County and Central Massachusetts on-site or remotely.

Business Builder is a family-owned Massachusetts company, building websites since 2016. We build and host websites and put AI to work inside small businesses: an AI receptionist named Atlas that answers the phone, chatbots that answer from a company's own documents, forms and document processing, lead intake and follow-up, email and SMS workflows, and private AI on hardware we control for businesses that cannot send data to a public AI cloud. Every AI engagement starts with a $1,500 discovery sprint that ends in a fixed quote and a timeline.

## Services

- [AI Integration & Automation](https://business-builder.online/ai-automation): The main AI page. Chatbots trained on your documents that cite their source, paperwork that processes itself, intake that qualifies leads at any hour. Four-step process: $1,500 discovery sprint, the build, a live acceptance test on your own cases, a monthly care plan. Systems hand off to a person when unsure; no silent failures.
- [AI Automation in Worcester County, MA](https://business-builder.online/ai-automation-worcester-county-ma): The local edition. Lead intake and follow-up, CRM and workflow automation, email and SMS workflows, forms and document processing, AI chatbots and knowledge assistants, connecting the software you already run, and AI voice agents, for small businesses in Worcester, Rutland, Holden, Sterling, Barre, Spencer, Leicester, Paxton, West Boylston, Shrewsbury, Auburn, Millbury, Westborough, Northborough, and Grafton. Examples for contractors, cleaning companies, landscapers, auto shops, real estate, fitness, retail, property management, bakeries, and professional services. FAQ included.
- [Atlas, the AI receptionist (live demo)](https://business-builder.online/atlas): Talk to an AI voice agent out loud in your browser, or call the live line at (508) 886-3046. Atlas says it is an AI, answers common questions from the facts it is given, takes the caller's name and number, asks what they need, sends the owner the conversation, and books a setup call where a calendar is connected.
- [Private AI](https://business-builder.online/private-ai): The same automation on private AI endpoints on hardware we control, for medical, legal, financial, and trade-secret data. From $3,500 per month.
- [Websites and hosting plans](https://business-builder.online/pricing): Self-service plans from $20 per month; done-for-you plans from $99 per month.
- [Blog](https://business-builder.online/blog): Notes on websites, hosting, and AI for small business.

## Quick facts

- What is AI automation? Software that can read, listen, and write, handling one specific, repeatable job in a business (answering a call, qualifying a lead, extracting the fields from an invoice, drafting a follow-up), connected to the tools the business already uses, and handing off to a person when it is not sure.
- Can an AI agent answer business phone calls? Yes. Atlas answers every call on the line it is set up on, tells the caller it is an AI, answers common questions, and takes a message with the caller's name, number, and request.
- What does it cost? A $1,500 discovery sprint first, then a fixed quote before any build. Deployed systems carry a monthly care plan. Private AI starts at $3,500 per month.
- Does it work with an existing website or CRM? In most cases yes; the discovery sprint confirms what the tools allow before the quote.
- Where does the data go? Public AI clouds only when it fits and the client approves; otherwise private AI on hardware we control.
- Service area: Worcester County and Central Massachusetts. Rutland, MA is the only office; the towns above are service areas.
